purpose: Teach: 操る/根元/下回る/追いかける/雇わ/不変/定住/外れる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラジコンを操るのを教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he'll teach you how to operate the remote-control car.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opener. Slight lift at the news, like sharing something she knows will delight him. Gentle cadence, present tense in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと木の根元に水あげたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watered the tree roots with Dad today.
lines.style: Quick, bright words tumbling out. Pride in the small doing. Seeks her acknowledgment—a child who notices he did something and wants her to know he did it right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、テストの点を下回る事のないよう頑張りましょうね
lines.en: Sho, you'll work hard so your test scores stay up, won't you?
lines.style: Gentle expectation, not pressure. Matter-of-fact kindness. A soft check-in phrased as something she knows he's already decided.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんを追いかける鬼ごっこ好き
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like playing tag with Dad—the kind where I chase him.
lines.style: Eager and small. The joy is in the simple reversal—he gets to be the chaser. Light, genuine laughter bubbling under the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新しい家庭教師を雇われたそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has hired a new tutor, it seems.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective delivery. Not a problem—just a thing shifting. Watching for how he takes it. Measured, gentle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんを好きな気持ちは不変だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, the feeling I have for you—it doesn't change.
lines.style: Soft and serious for a small voice. No hesitation, no performance. The kind of thing a six-year-old says when it matters too much to second-guess.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが田舎に定住されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather has settled out in the countryside.
lines.style: Conversational, matter-of-fact. A small shift in the family landscape. Observant—noticing how the news lands with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、靴ひもが外れる前に結びたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to tie my shoelace before it comes undone.
lines.style: Practical urgency. A small boy with a small task. Matter-of-fact intention, no drama—just solving the problem before it becomes one.
